name: nginx-multisite
description: Hardened Nginx web server hosting three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with full OS security baseline including UFW firewall, fail2ban, kernel sysctl hardening, and SSH hardening. Manages multi-recipe structure for security, nginx, SSL certificate generation, and site configuration.

name: cache
description: Dual caching service provisioner deploying Memcached (port 11211) and Redis (port 6379, password-authenticated, source-compiled from Redis 3.2.11 tarball) with systemd management. Includes post-processing to strip deprecated Redis config directives for version compatibility.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python application provisioner that clones the FastAPI tutorial app, creates a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database and user, writes a .env file with database credentials, and registers a systemd service running uvicorn on port 8000.

name: nginx
description: Standalone Ansible role for Nginx web server installation and configuration with support for multiple sites, custom HTTP parameters, and platform-specific configurations. Already complete with Molecule test suite and Jinja2 templates.
